text:
Maya: Heads-up — quick design review request. Found two related friction points in the autoscale & capacity controls: (1) the min/max stepper label is ambiguous (users think min is per-pool, not cluster-wide) and (2) pool search behaves weird when there are many GPU pools (typing resets suggestions). Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/autoscale-v2 :eyes:

Ken: Good catch. I noticed the same in the usability study yesterday — one user bumped min thinking it would only affect the selected pool and nearly doubled spend. We should clarify scope in the label and confirmation modal.

Sasha: Proposal: change "Min" -> "Min capacity (cluster)" and add secondary microcopy beneath the stepper: "Applies across selected pools unless scoped to a single pool via the pool selector." Short and keyboard-friendly.

Jamal: Love the explicitness but worried about copy length in tight layouts. Alternative: keep compact label but use an info icon with aria-label and a11y-friendly tooltip. Tooltip text could be the longer explanation.

Maya: Agree on tooltip for layout. Also accessibility nit: the increment/decrement buttons currently don't expose aria-live updates for screen readers when the value changes via keyboard hold. We should announce "Min capacity set to X GPUs."

design-bot: Automated contrast check: current stepper value (light gray on white) fails AA in small text. Recommendation: use #243A57 for value text or increase font weight to 600. :warning:

Ken: About pool search — when >100 pools we debounce server query but still clear suggestions on every keystroke; that makes it feel buggy. Two options: client-side prefix filter of cached page + remote search on enter OR keep last suggestion list until new results return. Prefers latter.

Sasha: Also UX: when user types a pool name that doesn't exist, we should show a subtle CTA: "Create pool" or "Request pool" depending on permissions. That prevents dead-ends.

Maya: For the guardrails SLO slider, accessibility note: slider should support arrow keys for 1% steps, PageUp/PageDown for 10% and add aria-describedby referencing a live summary: "SLO set to 98% — expected throughput impact: +8% latency". That summary can be synthesized based on model selection.

Jamal: Quick implementation detail — for the aria-live message we can reuse existing toaster util. Example code (pseudo):
```
// announce when slider stops
announce(`SLO set to ${value}% — estimated cost change ${delta}%`, {politeness: 'polite'});
```
Make sure it's debounced to avoid spammy reads.

Sasha: Microcopy suggestion for burst toggle: current label "Allow burst" sounds permissive. Try "Enable temporary burst capacity" + subtext "Automatically scales above max for short windows." Also move the toggle to the right edge of the card to avoid accidental taps on mobile.

Ken: UX QA: add a confirmation toast when user enables burst with a link to "billing impact" details. People accidentally leave burst on. Simple pattern: toast with "View estimated monthly cost" link.

Maya: Accessibility checklist to add to PR template: role, aria-live, aria-describedby, keyboard focus order, contrast, and mobile touch target checks for stepper and toggles. I'll draft the checklist.

design-bot: Figma notes created: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/autoscale-a11y-notes. Color+contrast variants attached.

Jamal: I'll take the aria-live + stepper announcements. Ken — can you handle the pool search behavior (keep suggestions until results)? Sasha — can you prototype the new labels & mobile placement?

Sasha: On it. Will post mockups by EOD and include copy variants (short vs. tooltip).

Ken: ETA for search fix? I can have a tiny patch by tomorrow morning and add tests to assert suggestions persist until response.

Maya: Thanks all. Quick follow-ups: (1) include copy for confirmation toast, (2) define thresholds for burst CTA, (3) add unit test for aria-live debounce. I'll open a ticket and assign owners. :thumbsup:

design-bot: Ticket created: REDWOOD-1428 — "Autoscale: min/max labeling, pool search a11y, burst microcopy". Link: https://tracker.example.com/REDWOOD-1428

Ken: :+1:

Sasha: :raised_hands:

Jamal: :shipit:
